name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your installer arrives, clear everything off your countertops and empty cabinets directly adjacent to the work area. Move small appliances, knife blocks, and spice racks to another room so workers have full, unobstructed access to the walls. Locate your electrical panel in case power to the backsplash outlets must be turned off to pull out receptacles or adjust junction boxes. If you have already purchased your tile, inspect the boxes for breakage and confirm you ordered roughly 10 to 15 percent extra to account for cuts, waste, and pattern matching.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all countertops, empty nearby cabinets, locate your electrical breaker box, and ensure you have ordered 10 to 15 percent extra tile for cuts and waste.
